title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page continues a technical verification from the previous page. There, Grothendieck needed to know that a certain one-parameter subgroup (the image of G_a, or of a group B'_0) is normal ('distingué') in a semidirect product S_0 M_{ρ,σ}, so that a quotient by it can be formed.

Setting, in modern terms:
- G is a group scheme.
- G*_{ρ,σ} (and its subgroup SG*_{ρ,σ}) is identified with a subgroup of a product B'_0 × T_ρ × N'_σ.
- This product acts on G only through the factor B'_0, and B'_0 acts by INNER automorphisms. B'_0 is a subgroup of G, or maps to G, since λ ∈ ΓB'_0 and λ^{-1} ∈ ΓG on the page.
- M_{ρ,σ} = G*_{ρ,σ} ⋉ G.

The 'main monomorphism' is formula (40):
  i : B'_0 → (B'_0×T_ρ×N'_σ) ⋉ G,  λ ↦ (λ, 1, 1, λ^{-1}) = i_B(λ)·i_G(λ^{-1}).
This is the standard 'anti-diagonal' embedding.

A first, struck-out attempt computed u·i(λ)·u^{-1} for a general element u = u_0·f directly. Grothendieck abandons it for a cleaner route:
- Embed SM*_{ρ,σ} = SG*_{ρ,σ} ⋉ G into the larger semidirect product (41): S̃M_{ρ,σ} = G*_{ρ,σ}·G ≅ (B'_0×T_ρ×N'_σ)·G.
- Show that the image of i is normal already in this larger group.
- To keep notation manageable, introduce in (42) names for the four evident morphisms i_B, i_ρ, i_σ, i_G from B'_0, T_ρ, N'_σ, G into S̃M_{ρ,σ}.

The next page carries out the check:
- i(λ) commutes with G, because i_B(λ) and i_G(λ) act identically on G.
- T_ρ and N'_σ act trivially on the image.
- Conjugation by i_B(x) sends i(λ) to i(x(λ)).
Hence i(B'_0) is normal and the quotient exists.

This is the elementary fact that if H acts on G through inner automorphisms via φ: H → G, then {(h, φ(h)^{-1})} is a normal subgroup of H ⋉ G, isomorphic to H and centralizing G, so H ⋉ G ≅ H × G.

The purpose within the manuscript: construct the quotient groups (e.g. by G_a in (39), or by L_0) needed to obtain the homomorphism (37) from S_0 M_{0,3} to SM_{ρ,σ}(Ẑ)/Σ̃. This is part of Grothendieck's study of the arithmetic/Galois symmetries attached to the 'loop equation' in the Teichmüller tower.
errors: No mathematical error. The struck-out direct computation of u·i(λ)·u^{-1} was abandoned in favour of the cleaner argument via the larger semidirect product (41).

Normality under i_B(x) requires that conjugation by x on B'_0 be compatible with its image in G. The next page handles this via i_B(x)(i_B(λ)) = i_B(x(λ)); it is fine because B'_0 → G is equivariant for inner actions.

ideas.what: In a semidirect product H ⋉ G where H acts through inner automorphisms via φ: H→G, the anti-diagonal elements (h, φ(h)^{-1}) form a normal subgroup isomorphic to H that centralizes G.
ideas.modern_name: untwisting of a semidirect product with inner action (H ⋉_inn G ≅ H × G)

ideas.what: Embedding SM*_{ρ,σ} into a larger semidirect product (B'_0×T_ρ×N'_σ)⋉G to verify normality of the image of B'_0, and to pass to quotients removing sign/scalar ambiguities.
ideas.modern_name: bookkeeping of normal subgroups in automorphism groups of (pro)algebraic fundamental groups
ideas.usually_credited_to: part of Grothendieck's unpublished Longue Marche material

deep.surprise_reason: Routine verification that an anti-diagonal subgroup is normal in a semidirect product with inner action. It is purely technical scaffolding for the larger construction on the neighbouring pages.
transcription_corrections: 'λ ∈ B'_0' and 'λ^{-1} ∈ G' under (40) should read 'λ ∈ ΓB'_0' and 'λ^{-1} ∈ ΓG' (Γ = sections; the image shows ⊢-like Γ symbols).
'opérant sur G par automorphismes extérieurs via B'_0' is more likely 'par autom. int[érieurs] via B'_0', consistent with the next page ('fait opérer ... intérieurement via le facteur B'_0').
Line 4 likely reads 'Le monomorphisme principal correspondant est :'.
'et on ne voit que l'image' is more plausibly 'et on voit que l'image du mono i (40) dans G*_{ρ,σ}·G est distinguée dans ce groupe plus grand'.

'Pour un peu on y perd tous les automorphismes ... on n'y peut dire que' is likely 'Pour ne pas se perdre dans les notations, je vais désigner par (42) i_B, i_ρ, i_σ, i_G les morphismes évidents/d'inclusion'.
The marginal note 'ou u_0' belongs at the left margin near the struck passage.
The page number in the corner is 390; the neighbouring page numbers in the transcriptions (498, 397) look misread.
